title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1968-10-20
lineage: SBD > Rm > DAT > CD > Sonic Solutions > CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Miller soundboard captures a fire‑filled Greek Theatre set highlighted by a smoking Dark Star, The Eleven > Caution and soaring Lovelight.
ai_review.review: This Miller SBD recording is praised for its crystal‑clear mix (with only a tiny buzz on Lovelight and a faint Garcia lead on Schoolgirl).  The performance is described as “packed with energy” – Dark Star, The Eleven into Caution, Lovelight, St. Stephen and the rest of the set are repeatedly called smoking, tight and magical.  Overall listeners consider it one of the standout 1968 shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, the vast majority are 5‑star and extol both the music and sound quality; only a few minor complaints exist, leading to a strong positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with every instrument and vocal distinct. Minor issues noted: slight buzz on Lovelight and Garcia's guitar a bit faint on Schoolgirl, but overall superb Miller SBD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short but tightly sequenced set that moves from a blazing Dark Star into The Eleven‑Caution transition, then lifts into Lovelight and closes with high‑energy St. Stephen and Feedback.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for hypnotic, flowing guitar work on Dark Star, amazing fills on Lovelight; tone described as perfect.
band_member_comments.Phil: Called “in charge,” with a nasty, prominent bass line on Schoolgirl and an extended solo in the second half; often highlighted as being front‑and‑center in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen’s vocals and organ work described as "rocking" and tip‑top; his presence noted throughout.
